title: Legacy OrthoCamera
description: A port of DimasKama's OrthoCamera to 1.8.9
body:
# Legacy OrthoCamera
A port of DimasKama's OrthoCamera to 1.8.9.

Provides an alternative camera view to visualize large areas.

![Example image of Orthographic Camera](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2224a6bb4629afb883ccf8467eeb03b2eb8c1fd1_0.webp)

## Original Mod
For more details, review the original mod's page. Many of the features presented there are also present in this port:

https://modrinth.com/mod/orthocamera

## Core features of (Legacy) OrthoCamera
1. A client-side Minecraft Fabric mod that adds a toggleable & configurable orthographic camera mode.
2. The orthographic camera keeps everything the same scale regardless of distance.
3. Highly configurable: includes a config screen (via ModMenu or hotkey) to customize various features such as scale, hotkeys, etc.

## Changes
Legacy OrthoCamera implements a few notable changes:
1. Through the config screen, you can now show/hide the cursor while in orthocam. This only hides the cursor in ortho, not first or third person.
2. Since the clouds obfuscate a lot in earlier versions, there is a setting to disable clouds in ortho. This only hides the clouds in ortho, not first or third person.

## How to build

`gradlew build`

## Permissions
Feel free to use Legacy OrthoCamera in any mods or modpacks.
